caption: The drawing depicts two metallic objects shaped like small buildings, both resembling banks. They are rendered in shades of grey and silver with subtle greenish and brownish tints giving a metallic appearance. Both objects have prominent rounded tops with a knob-like structure at the peak. The one on the left is shown in three-quarters view, displaying a cylindrical front with a vertical slot near the top, small windows, and an arched doorway; the sides have additional rectangular windows and small rivet details. The object on the right is shown in a frontal view. It has the word "BANK" embossed above the doorway, which features an arched entrance and two small windows above it, flanked by square windows on either side. The background is plain and cream-colored with no other objects or features, and the artist's signature "W.O.Fletcher" appears at the lower right corner.
title: Byzantine Dome Coin Bank
